'Juuou Mujin Dandivine' Announces Additional Cast
The official website for the Juuou Mujin Dandivine (Beast King War God Dandivine) original television anime announced additional cast members on Friday. 'Kagurabachi' Announces Additional Cast Pair
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Takeru Hokazono's Kagurabachi manga revealed two additional cast and character promotional videos on Friday. The anime is scheduled to air in Spring 2027. Voice actresses Miku Itou (5-toubun no Hanayome) and Miyari Nemoto (Ruri no Houseki) are joining the cast as Hinao and Char Kyounagi, respectively. Bringing 'The Last Blossom' to Life: 'ODD TAXI' Team Returns with 'Housenka'
Following their acclaimed work ODD TAXI, director Baku Kinoshita and writer Kazuya Konomoto return with Housenka (The Last Blossom), an original movie from animation studio CLAP and produced by Pony Canyon. Premiering in Japan on October 10, 2025 after its world debut at the Annecy International Film Festival 2025, the movie presents a grounded human story rooted in the realities of everyday life, with the fantastical touch of a talking flower that adds a bit of whimsy to its candid themes.
